units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 24:2">Targ. Jer. XXIV, 2</cite>; a. e.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 31:52">Targ. O. Gen. XXXI, 52</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 156a:8">Sabb. 156ᵃ</cite> <he>חדא לב׳</he> one quality on the bad side; <he>כולי לב׳</he> all bad.

<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">Lam. R. to I, 1</cite> <he>בישו עבדית וכ׳</he> (<cite ref="T00152"><he>רבתי</he></cite>) (not <he>בישי</he>) have I done wrong that I &c.? Pesik. Zakh. p. 24ᵇ [read twice:] <he>למיגזי לבישא בִּישׁוּתֵיה</he>; (Tanḥ. Ki Thetse 6 <he>בִּישְׁתֵּיה</he>, ed. Bub. ib. <he>בישותיה</he>) to repay the bad man his badness.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 115a:16">B. Kam. 115ᵃ</cite> <he>מפורסם לב׳</he> notorious for vice.—
<cite ref="Menachot 52a:16">Men. 52ᵃ</cite> <he>מבישותין וכ׳</he> of our shortcomings they speak to them.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 65a:4">Ab. Zar. 65ᵃ</cite> <he>עינא … ב׳</he> the eye which desires to see your misfortune.

<cite ref="Ketubot 25b:6">Keth. 25ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Makkot 5b:4">Macc. 5ᵇ</cite> <he>הדר הזייה לר׳ א׳ בישות</he> he turned around and looked at R. E. with displeasure; <cite ref="Pesachim 53b:13">Pes. 53ᵇ</cite> <he>חזא ביה … ב׳</he> (Ms. M. 2 a. Oxf. <he>בבישות</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 400).—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 3:4:2">Y. Taan. III, 66ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>ומדינתא אזלא בבאישות</he> and the city perishes in wickedness (by pestilence).
